title: Ivo and the Oath
premise: Oscar Nakamura, a cartographer whose gift lets them chart realms that exist only in memory, has hidden for years in a valley where magic cannot follow. When the crown's witch-hunt reaches the valley, Oscar flees with a dying oathkeeper named Ivo, who carries the last unbroken oath binding King Aldric to the Hollow Thing wearing his crown. To free Aldric, Oscar must map the palace's forgotten heart—a place that erases the memories of anyone who enters—and choose between preserving their own past and saving a kingdom. In the end, Oscar unbinds the king by surrendering their own name to the map, becoming the valley's newest legend while Ivo, healed, carries their story home.
about_author: Orsen Ashgrove is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing maps of places that no longer exist. They write fantasy about people caught between what they remember and what they owe.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar lives quietly in the magic-dead valley, drawing impossible maps from dreams, until crown soldiers arrive hunting the gifted and an old oathkeeper, Ivo, collapses at their door carrying a sealed oath. Forced to flee together, Oscar feels the first crack in their safe invisibility. Emotional beat: fear giving way to reluctant purpose.

chapters.title: An Oath in Ash
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. On the road to the capital, Ivo reveals the truth: King Aldric was bound body and soul to the Hollow Thing decades ago, and only an oathbearer and a mapmaker can reach the binding. Pursued by hunters, Ivo wrestles with guilt over the comrades he outlived. Emotional beat: loyalty tested as confession deepens trust between them.

chapters.title: The Palace of Unmapping
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Inside the capital, Oscar charts the palace's forgotten heart, where corridors rearrange and memories bleed away with every step. They confront the Hollow Thing wearing Aldric's crown and discover it feeds on oaths—meaning Ivo's bond is both the key and the bait. Climax: Oscar begins mapping the binding as their own memories start dissolving.

chapters.title: What the Map Keeps
chapters.summary: Alternating POV, ending on Ivo's. Oscar completes the counter-map and unbinds Aldric by writing their own name into the forgotten heart, trading identity for freedom; the king wakes, the Thing unravels. Ivo carries the nameless cartographer back to the valley, where the land itself remembers them. Resolution: love outlasting memory, duty fulfilled at cost.
